en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European spa or small town nestled in forested hills. In the lower left stands a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance style building with arched windows and a flat, balustraded roof; behind and above the town on the right is a hilltop church with a tall tower and onion‑shaped spire. Smaller houses with pitched roofs sit among dense trees in the valley. The image has the framing and composition of an early 20th‑century postcard.
